title: Cosmic Braided Muse
description: A close-up portrait of a woman with cracked purple skin and vivid green eyes, her hair styled in an intricate purple braid adorned with yellow flowers that swirl into a cosmic vortex. The background features a starry blue night sky with swirling galaxy patterns, bare black branches, and multiple glowing circular portals containing miniature scenes and faces.
prompt: A surreal portrait of a woman with cracked purple skin and bright green eyes, her long purple hair styled in an intricate braid that flows into a swirling cosmic vortex. Yellow flowers are woven into the braid and float around her. The background is a deep blue starry sky with black bare branches and multiple glowing circular portals showing miniature landscapes and faces, ethereal and mystical atmosphere.
